description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Land Acquisition - Kesbewa, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Weragampita, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Katuwangoda, Malimbada D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for water supply infrastructure projects, including exact locations, boundaries, extents, and claimant information. While it mentions a minister (Rauff Hakeem) and references legal authority, the core content focuses on land/property acquisition rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring, making it a Land Gazette.
